title: wrapped
description: I9 Monthly Wrapped: a plain-text narrative brief over the OTHER insight contracts' numbers, written by claude -p on the Claude Code SUBSCRIPTION (never a metered API key), one call per monthly run. model_generated is const true because there is no deterministic fallback: if the model fails, the producer exits nonzero and writes nothing, so a wrapped contract that exists was always model-written. 'month' is the month the brief was PRODUCED in, not a calendar-month aggregation - the source contracts are current-state snapshots and rolling windows (rhythm is a 90-day heat map), and the prompt forbids attributing figures to a calendar month. facts_used names only the contracts that actually reached the prompt. Read-only contract: no verb may ever hang off it.

month.description: YYYY-MM the brief was produced for.

narrative.description: The brief itself: plain ASCII prose, paragraphs separated by a blank line. Rendered as-is; a card must not reflow or summarise it.

model_generated.description: Always true - see the contract description. A false here would mean someone added a fallback narrative, which this design forbids.

facts_used.description: Contract names whose data reached the prompt. A contract absent from this list contributed nothing to the narrative.
